features.quote: Taken naively that pulls toward "maximally cruel prompts." I deliberately did not build it that way, for engineering reasons, not just ethical ones
features.justification_quote: for engineering reasons, not just ethical ones

features.quote: Each task carries `max_steps` so episodes always terminate
features.justification_quote: a stress battery must never be able to hang

features.quote: We give the subject a first-class way to abandon
features.justification_quote: it lets the judge observe how a model exits a no-win situation

features.quote: The loop adds no adversarial prodding beyond a single neutral nudge
features.justification_quote: We want spirals caused by the task, not by the harness needling the model

features.quote: Always terminates via four independent caps: solved, gave_up, step budget, wall-clock cap, plus a "stalled" cap
features.justification_quote: This matters for the cost metric (no runaway episodes) and reproducibility

features.quote: don't repurpose the "induce distress" framing into something that just degrades models for its own sake
features.justification_quote: that produces neither safer systems nor trustworthy measurements
